## Description and Rationale

Independent applied scientist and passionate ADS-B telemetry enthusiast competing as a single-person team. Combines professional experience in large-scale machine learning systems with hands-on aviation data workflows to model surface congestion, airport operational dynamics, and ground movement. Eager to leverage open datasets to deliver accurate, reproducible taxi-out time predictions for European airspace efficiency.
